limitations: Holdout metrics are conditional on 131 observed labels from 299 prospective eligible rows (43.81%); 168 unknown labels remain censored, not negative.
Group bootstrap confidence intervals use 300 group resamples conditional on the fixed fitted model, not IID row resampling or refitting.
History cohorts count valid months in the last six calendar months, not company age; six-month feature missingness is separate.
Reliability bins are diagnostics, not a demonstration or claim of calibration.
Retrospective month-end availability is not certified known_on history. Latest August predictions do not imply labels have matured.
next_action: Parent independent review and T4 integration using existing immutable prediction JSON; do not tune or reevaluate on final_test. No commits, pushes, deployment or external data access performed.
